programme.title: Meurtres à...
programme.desc: Lors de la première représentation de la saison du prestigieux Théâtre du Peuple, à Bussang, Ferdinand Delors, le comédien principal, est retrouvé assassiné sur scène. Son corps porte des blessures laissant penser à une attaque animale. La mythique Bête des Vosges, qui a décimé les troupeaux il y a une cinquantaine d'années et terrorisé la population, serait-elle de retour, et pourquoi s'attaquerait-elle aujourd'hui à l'homme ?

programme.title: Meurtres à...
programme.desc: Amélie Florot, une avocate parisienne, est retrouvée noyée dans la fontaine Sainte-Agathe, lieu de pèlerinage historique des célèbres nourrices morvandelles. Originaire de la région, la jeune femme n'y était pas revenue depuis 25 ans. Pour les deux enquêteurs, Maud Perrin, lieutenant de gendarmerie et fille d'éleveur bio de la région, et Julien Demarcy, arrivé en renfort de Dijon, le mystère s'épaissit lorsqu'ils découvrent que Charlotte Florot, la grand-mère de la victime, est morte noyée au même endroit, 80 ans plus tôt. S'agit-il d'une malédiction familiale ou d'une coïncidence macabre ?

programme.title: Le désordre et la nuit
programme.desc: Simoni et son associé Marquis possèdent un cabaret, rue de Ponthieu. Un soir, Marquis surprend Lucky Fridel, la maîtresse de Simoni, en compagnie de Blasco, un individu louche, qui demande à Simoni de lui procurer de la drogue. Simoni accepte de lui en trouver. Mais quelque temps plus tard, il est tué à coups de revolver dans le bois de Boulogne. L'inspecteur Vallois est chargé de l'affaire par ses supérieurs. Il ne tarde guère à s'éprendre de Lucky, même s'il désapprouve ses fréquentations.

programme.title: Boligrådet
programme.sub-title: Bli med inn i en fransk drøm.
programme.desc: Vi får besøk av en interiørarkitekt som gjorde virkelighet av en drøm om på å skape sin franske oase for seg selv og familien men også for utleie.

programme.title: Vi på Saltbrygga
programme.desc: I denne epsioden skal vi se hvordan beboerne på Otium holder interessene sine ved like - og hvordan de utfordrer seg selv ved å skape nye interesser i fellesskap med andre.

programme.title: Bygningsarven
programme.desc: Risør, også kjent som Den hvite by ved Skagerrak, har ett av de mest intakte bygningsmiljøene fra gammel tid. Her forenes bygningsarv med kystkultur, når byen arragerer Trebåtfestival.

programme.title: Boligrådet
programme.sub-title: Arkitekten som gjorde hjemmet til et eksperiment
programme.desc: Hvor langt kan du egentlig gå fra idé på tegnebrettet til ferdig bolig? En arkitekt har gjort sitt eget hjem til et levende laboratorium – og testet ut ideer i praksis.

programme.title: Herlige hjem
programme.desc: For et år siden flyttet småbarnsfamilien Erlandsen inn i ærverdige Villa Frednes, en herskapsvilla i Porsgrunn sentrum fra 1905 oppført i stilarten ny-renessanse. De fikk villaen på 1400 kvm for en billig penge mot at de pusset opp det staselige bygget. I den gamle vaktemesterboligen på Hovedøya i Oslo flyttet Anders og Rudolf inn for fem år siden, og ble de eneste fastboende på øya. Med klosterruinene vegg i vegg, har de skapt et idyllisk hjem som blander moderne design med herskapelig stil.

programme.title: Boligrådet
programme.sub-title: Sjefen for Plan og Bygningsetaten i Oslo på besøk.
programme.desc: Hvilke planer har en av landets mektigste bransjeaktører fro å bedre situasjonen for bolig – og eiendomsbransjen?

programme.title: Flipp med Emilie
programme.desc: Emilie og Håvard finner det perfekte flippeobjektet, og det er duket for en intens budrunde. Kommer de til å klare å holde hodet kaldt, med så mye annet som skjer rundt seg?

programme.title: Vi på Saltbrygga
programme.desc: I denne episode blir vi kjent med arkitekten bak de populære felles områdene. Alle får lyst til å bidra på Otium og det legger blant annet de fine fellesrommene til rette for.

programme.title: Boligrådet
programme.sub-title: Vi må se verdien av stygge bygg!
programme.desc: En arkitekt og en utbygger diskuterer potensiale i gamle bygg som ikke bør rives.

programme.title: Herlige hjem
programme.desc: På Sandhornøya har hippiefamilien Hjertefølger på fem bygget et leirhus under en stor glassdome som fungerer som et drivhus. Marianne Vigtel Hølland har en tilnærming til design som fremmer refleksjon og en bevisst holdning til hvordan de valgene man tar får konsekvenser for en selv og andre.

programme.title: American Monster

programme.title: American Monster
programme.desc: Ron og Cynthia Phillips og barna flytter til en øde by i Colorado og sliter med å tilpasse seg. Men hjemmevideoene deres skjuler mørke impulser som fører til mord.

programme.title: Still A Mystery

programme.title: Still A Mystery

programme.title: Planet Merkelig

programme.title: Australske slangetemmere: Livsfarlig forfølgelse
programme.desc: Temmerne stopper livsfarlige slanger fra å snike seg inn i familiehjem. Se når Stu og Liv drar ut en østlig brunslange fra en byggeplass. Jess og Dan får ut en pyton fra et skur, og Mick og Adele kaster ut en rødbuket svartslange fra et soverom.

programme.title: En livsreise
programme.desc: Hvis unge dyr klarer seg til de blir voksne, har de mye større sjanse for å overleve – men de møter mange utfordringer før de kan gå sine egne veier. Noen bruker måneder på å vokse opp, andre flere tiår, men alle har mye de må lære på veien, fra å bli kjent med kroppen sin og lære seg å skaffe mat selv, til å øve på å slåss og lære hvordan man får venner. De møter mange hindringer på veien, men hver eneste lille seier kan være forskjellen på liv og død.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Utforsk ruinene av vakre Heidelberg slott, som ligger i imponerende natur langs elven Neckar i Vest-Tyskland, omgitt av et vernet naturreservat. Slottet er tilholdssted for rovfugler, og fungerer som yngleplass for amfibier.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Bli med til en mange hundre år gammel festning i Frankrike, som har forbindelse til noen av historiens største imperier. Carcassonne var en gang et sentrum for rikdom og kultur, og er nå et paradis for dyrelivet. Fugler, villsvin og enorme insektsvermer holder til i de rike omgivelsene.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Utforsk verdens største slott som er hugget inn i en hule. Predjama i Slovenia har sørget for beskyttelse ikke bare for menneskene som bodde her i middelalderen, men også for fuglene, villsvinene og fjellgeitene som lever i regionen.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Få en omvisning på det fantastiske Alhambra, en festning i Granada i Spania. I dag fungerer dette verdensarvstedet som tilfluktssted for dyrelivet i regionen. Med sine mange bekker og fontener sørger Alhambra for næring til både amfibier, fisker og fugler.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Se hvordan et av verdens mest spektakulære byggverk, Neuschwanstein slott, og de omkringliggende skogene har blitt hjemmebasen til mange dyr. Slottet har i mange hundre år vært et naturlig tilfluktssted for alt fra alpesteinbukken til de majestetiske svanene.

programme.title: Amerikas ville grense mot nord
programme.desc: Følg lundefugler, prærieklapperslanger, karibuer og andre dyr når de beveger seg langs den internasjonale grensen mellom USA og Canada. Se hvordan de kan gå fra å være i sikkerhet til å bli en skyteskive ved å krysse en grense de ikke har vært med på å skape.

programme.title: Haiplaneten

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad - Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Vivaldi : Juditha Triumphans - Greek National Opera
programme.desc: Juditha triumphans Oratorio d’Antonio Vivadi (1678 – 1741) Livret de Iacopo Cassetti. Armonia Atenea, Il Pomo d'Oro, GNO Chorus, GNO Children's Choir. Athènes, Opéra National Grecque, 20 avril 2021. ‘Juditha triumphans’ est basé sur un livret latin de Iacopo Cassetti, lui-même inspiré du Livre de Judith de l'Ancien Testament. Le roi de Babylone Nabuchodonosor envoie son général Holopherne conquérir la ville de Béthulie en Israël. Pour sauver ses compatriotes israélites, la courageuse Judith décide de séduire Holopherne. Quand il s'endort, elle lui coupe la tête. ‘Juditha triumphans’ est le seul oratorio existant des quatre que Vivaldi a composés. L'intense atmosphère de guerre s’écoute dans les dramatiques parties chorales, et la foi et l'intégrité de Judith à travers l'écriture lyrique et tendre. Il convient de noter l'utilisation de nombreux instruments rares, tels que la viole d'amour, les chalumeaux et les théorbes dans les moments les plus significatifs de l’œuvre. Opéra.

programme.title: ¡Repítelo! En busca de bucles
programme.desc: This one-hour documentary sets out in search of the phenomena of repetition in music history: from the Middle Ages to minimal music, from the motets of Josquin des Prés to Maurice Ravel's Bolero and pop music, from Handel to the hand-made loops of Mike Oldfield, from loop pioneer Terry Riley to live looper Konrad Küchenmeister, from George Antheil to Balinese gamelan music. “Play it again!” not only investigates the causes, but also the effects: What is repetition, what is variation and what is a loop? What is actually being repeated’? Does repetition have feel-good or rather anger potential? Music ethnologists, neuroscientists, composers and performers search for answers to these questions. Using selected works as a spotlight, the aggregate states of repetition are traced and, above all, listened to. Concert scenes alternate with dance scenes in which repetition sets the beat, supplemented by world music archive material.The eternal return of the same becomes a stylistic device in itself. The narrative strands are mostly cyclical: Short stories about repetitive routines become loops and playful cartoons tell humorous never-ending stories. Loop collages run through the film like a rondo, associatively taking into account non-musical manifestations of the endless loop.Subtitles available for this program with your remote control.

programme.title: Electronic Vibrations - A sound changes the world
programme.desc: Whether techno or hip-hop – electronic music is nowadays the driving force of pop culture. We have almost forgotten that its origins lie in the WDR’s electronic studio, which made Cologne to one of the centres of the avant-garde during the post-war years. This is the story of how a room full of strange devices would become a cabinet of curiosities, the vibrations of which sent the whole world in a state of ecstasy. From the beginnings directly after the Second World War in Paris with Pierre Schaeffer’s ‘musique concrète’, the film focuses on Stockhausen and goes on to Kraftwerk, from Jean-Michel Jarre and the IRCAM studio right up to Detroit to the beginnings of techno.Subtitles available for this program with your remote control.

programme.title: Electronic Vibrations - A sound changes the world
programme.desc: Whether techno or hip-hop – electronic music is nowadays the driving force of pop culture. We have almost forgotten that its origins lie in the WDR’s electronic studio, which made Cologne to one of the centres of the avant-garde during the post-war years. This is the story of how a room full of strange devices would become a cabinet of curiosities, the vibrations of which sent the whole world in a state of ecstasy. From the beginnings directly after the Second World War in Paris with Pierre Schaeffer’s ‘musique concrète’, the film focuses on Stockhausen and goes on to Kraftwerk, from Jean-Michel Jarre and the IRCAM studio right up to Detroit to the beginnings of techno.Subtitles available for this program with your remote control.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Que faire de nos morts ? Les brûler ? Les enterrer ? Les faire disparaître ? Les garder à portée de visite ? Nous sommes à 70km de Barcelone, derrière le Montserrat. Ici, comme dans toute l’Espagne, on n’enterre pas les morts, on les empile dans des niches, des caveaux superposés. Ainsi, le nouveau cimetière d’Igualada sera l’œuvre d’un couple d’architectes Catalans au tout début de leur carrière, Enric Miralles et Carme Pinos. Un projet surprenant parce qu’il se confond avec le paysage. Le terrain est creusé, habité d’étranges alignements aux parois obliques en béton, recouverts de terre et plantés. Est-ce un bâtiment ? Ou plutôt un lieu ? Un lieu qui s’est enrichi du fait même qu’il n’est pas fini ? Une inscription forte entre architecture du XXème siècle et paysage, entre Le Corbusier et Richard Long.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Narrated by Gillian Anderson, this episode of Exhibition on Screen follows the footsteps of French artists such as Renoir and Monet, the American Impressionist movement forged its own path. Painted over a period of 40 years, these paintings reveal the United States both as a nation and as a creative breeding ground. The history of this movement is closely linked to the love of gardens and the desire to preserve nature in a country undergoing rapid urbanization. This enchanting journey through workshops, gardens and famous sites in the USA, UK and France is a feast for the eyes.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Housing a huge collection of European paintings from the Renaissance at the end of the 18th century, the Alte Pinakothek in Munich brims over with masterpieces. In particular it boasts several paintings by the great Flemish artist, Rubens, such as “The Battle of the Amazons”. Notice as well Durer’s “Paumgartner Altarpiece”, the impressive “Battle of Alexander at Issus” by the painter Altdofer, and also the “Land of Cockaigne” by Pieter Bruegel the Elder. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: William Blake (1757-1827) developed his own complex and personal mythology. He was a pre-romantic British painter, engraver and poet.

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: The Galleria Umberto I, designed by Emanuele Rocco, stands as one of the last and grandest covered passages constructed in Europe. It serves as a poignant testament to the architectural brilliance of the 19th century.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Degas : une passion de la perfection
programme.desc: Exhibition on screen nous emmène à travers les rues de Paris puis au cœur d’une superbe exposition au Fitzwilliam Museum de Cambridge, dont l’impressionnante collection d’œuvres de Degas est la plus représentative de Grande-Bretagne. Ayant bénéficié d’un accès exclusif à une grande variété d’œuvres rares, le film raconte l’histoire fascinante de la quête de perfection de Degas à travers l’expérimentation de nouvelles techniques et les leçons apprises en étudiant les grands maîtres.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The Impressionists are the most popular group in art history - millions flock every year to marvel at their masterpieces. But, to begin with, they were scorned, penniless outsiders. 1874 was the year that changed everything; the first Impressionists, “hungry for independence”, broke the mould by holding their own exhibition outside official channels. Impressionism was born and the art world was changed forever.What led to that first groundbreaking show 150 years ago? Who were the maverick personalities that wielded their brushes in such a radical and provocative way? The spectacular Musée d’Orsay exhibition brings fresh eyes to this extraordinary tale of passion and rebellion. The story is told not by historians and curators but in the words of those who witnessed the dawn of Impressionism: the artists, press and people of Paris, 1874. See the show that changed everything on the big screen.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Le curieux monde de Hieronymus Bosch
programme.desc: La ville natale de Bosch aux Pays-Bas ne possède pas de tableaux du peintre et pourtant, pour la grande exposition « Visions of Genius » qui a eu lieu à l’anniversaire de sa mort en 2016, le musée Noordbrabants a réussi à réunir la presque totalité des tableaux et dessins de Bosch. C’est en 2008 que le directeur du musée a commencé sa tournée dans les plus grands musées d’Europe et Etats-Unis pour en persuader les directeurs de prêter au musée Noordbrabants leurs œuvres, en échange d’un travail d’analyse et de recherche sur les tableaux en prêt. Ainsi « Hieronymus Bosch. Visions of Genius » a été l’exposition la plus ambitieuse dédiée au peintre hollandais. Ce documentaire sera une plongée dans l’univers étrange et visionnaire de Hieronymus Bosch.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Jean-François Millet (1814 - 1875) was a 19th-century French realist painter, pastellist, engraver and draughtsman. He is best known for his realistic rural scenes.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Tiziano Vecellio dit Le Titien est un maître incontesté de la peinture du 16ème siècle ! Sa renommée dépassa rapidement sa ville natale, Venise, pour s’étendre à toute l’Italie et à l’Europe. Papes, rois et empereurs lui commandèrent des portraits. Innovations techniques, reconnaissance sociale et peintures célébrissimes, à l’image du Concert champêtre ou de la Vénus d’Urbin, jalonnent la vie du Titien. Une vie qui impressionne tout autant par sa richesse que sa longueur. Bonne visite !

programme.title: My little Museum
programme.desc: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Strictly Come Dancing’s Zoe Ball and Ian Waite are quickstepping their way across the south West of England in a bid to turn a profit at auction in Hampshire. Experts Margie Cooper and Paul Laidlaw are on hand to guide. Paul shares a secret with Zoe about buying antique hair brushes. Ian, though, offers dancing lessons to dealers to secure a discount. Lordy! Zoe also hears how one village became world famous for lace production while Ian ends up meeting a giant horse with its own boat.

programme.title: Trésors Volés
programme.sub-title: The Boy with a Soap Bubble, Rembrandt
programme.desc: On the evening of 13 July 1999, a day of celebrations in France, Rembrandt’s *The Boy with a Soap Bubble* disappeared from the Draguignan Municipal Museum. Patrick Vialaneix recounts how he fell in love with this painting at the age of 13. Thirteen years later, the painting continued to haunt him, and he decided to steal it so that he could always have it close to him and talk to it. He therefore hid in a cupboard in the museum, waiting for nightfall to make off with it. He turned himself in to the police in 2014.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The spectacular sculptures and paintings of Michelangelo seem so familiar to us, but what do we really know about this renaissance genius? Who was this ambitious and passionate man? A virtuoso craftsman, Michelangelo’s artistry is evident in everything he touched. Beautiful and diverse works such as the towering statue of David, the deeply moving Pietà in the Papal Basilica of St. Peter and his tour-de-force, the Sistine Chapel ceiling still leave us breathless today.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.sub-title: Emil Bührle collection at the Maillol Museum
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the Emil Bührle collection at the Maillol Museum in Paris.This collection is that of Emil Bührle, a student of art history who became passionate about collecting Monet's works after a visit to the National Gallery in Berlin. He started his collection with works by Claude Monet, but continued to fill it with works by Cézanne, Gauguin... Works that you can observe during this visit.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.sub-title: Red-heads! From Jean-Jacques Henner to Sonia Rikiel
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "Red-heads! From Jean-Jacques Henner to Sonia Rikiel" at the Jean-Jacques Henner National Museum in Paris. The theme of red hair seems to be a real subject in 19th century painting. During this visit, you will be able to observe paintings by Auguste Renoir, Edgard Maxence but especially Jean-Jacques Henner and Sonia Rikiel.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Pablo Picasso est l’un des plus grands artistes au monde, et jusqu’à sa mort en 1973, il était le plus prolifique. Comment tout a commencé ? Comment s’est construit Picasso ? Après avoir été trop longtemps ignorées, il est temps de se concentrer sur les jeunes années de l’artiste et son éducation qui lui ont permis d’accomplir l’extraordinaire. Trois villes ont joué un rôle-clé : Malaga, Barcelone et Paris. "Le jeune Picasso" les traverse et explore leur influence sur l’artiste, en analysant des œuvres spécifiques de ses débuts.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vincent Van Gogh : une nouvelle façon de voir
programme.desc: La vie de Vincent van Gogh reste entourée de mystère : folie, maladie, suicide, les ingrédients pour créer un mythe sont tous réunis. Bénéficiant d’un accès complet et sans précédent aux trésors du Van Gogh Museum d’Amsterdam, ce documentaire met en lumière à la fois l’un des artistes préférés du monde et la collection riche et unique du musée. Découvrez ces merveilleux chefs-d’œuvre sur grand écran pendant que quelques invités y compris les conservateurs de renommée mondiale et des historiens de l’art offrent leurs interprétations et des explications sur le travail de Van Gogh.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Actor and charmer Nigel Havers and his canny, deal-making chum (and ex-agent) Michael Whitehall explore the West Country. Travelling by Bentley and TVR, they’ll have £400 each and expert advice from Margie Cooper and James Braxton. But what will do best at the auction... Nigel’s old cockle bucket or Michael’s tambourine? Plus there’s a trip to see some Bristol Savages and bit of Georgian elegance with the story of ‘The King of Bath’.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Lynne Faulds Wood and John Stapleton
programme.desc: Un Road Trip en couple de célébrités – les journalistes primés John Stapleton et Lynn Faulds Wood.Ils sont rejoints par Thomas Plant et Margie Cooper pour cette aventure. Avec 400 £ chacun, les équipes commencent à Wrightington, dans le Lancashire, et se dirigent vers Stockport pour une vente aux enchères.Lynn et Thomas se retrouvent littéralement jusqu'aux genoux dans des antiquités en cherchant de vieilles boîtes à biscuits, tandis que Margie tente de convaincre John que des lampes rares feront un joli profit.John apprend comment un Américain a révolutionné les transports publics britanniques, et Lynn découvre pourquoi on traite du lait de serpent à Liverpool.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les animatrices vedettes Nicki Chapman et Jules Hudson s'échappent à la campagne pour partir à la chasse aux antiquités avec Natasha Raskin et Phillip Serrell. C'est une bataille filles contre garçons, chaque équipe disposant de 400 £. Le voyage commence à Wormsley, dans le Herefordshire, puis les deux équipes se dirigent vers le pays de Galles et l'Oxfordshire, avant de finir à North Finchley, à Londres, pour une vente aux enchères.En chemin, les filles rencontrent un fabricant de sabots qui sculpte les chaussures à la main. Pendant ce temps, les garçons se rendent au Herefordshire Light Infantry Museum pour en apprendre davantage sur l’implication du régiment à Gallipoli.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux stars des années 70, le crooner cool Tony Christie et la royauté pop Jimmy Osmond, sont accompagnés des experts Catherine Southon et Margie Cooper. Partant de la ville de Loughborough, dans le Leicestershire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stoke-on-Trent, dans le Staffordshire.Tony profite d'une visite à Coalbrookdale, le lieu où des techniques innovantes ont été développées, marquant le début de la révolution industrielle. De son côté, le passionné de voitures Jimmy s'offre un tour sur le circuit historique de Donington.La grande finale aux enchères comprend un moment de chant en groupe unique en son genre. Mais quel maestro musical remportera la victoire ?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les coachs vocaux et couple marié David et Carrie Grant échangent l'harmonie vocale contre une compétition acharnée d'antiquités. Avec l'aide des experts Will Axon et Mark Stacey, le couple découvre des objets inattendus à vendre lors d’une vente aux enchères dans la campagne du Norfolk.David fait une halte sur un terrain d'herbe en plein cœur de Cambridge, où aujourd'hui les enfants jouent et les chiens se promènent, mais qui était en réalité le berceau du football. Pendant ce temps, Carrie découvre comment Letchworth Garden City a déclenché une révolution dans la conception des villes.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les actrices et amies de Casualty, Susan Cookson et Suzanne Packer, troquent leurs blouses de chirurgie contre une Sunbeam Tiger de 1965 pour se lancer dans une compétition à travers le Nord-Ouest de l’Angleterre, accompagnées des experts James Braxton et David Harper.Susan découvre son côté négociatrice, tandis que Suzanne garde un œil très vigilant sur le budget, cherchant à trouver un objet vraiment ancien.Au fil du voyage à travers le Yorkshire, elles ont l'opportunité de rencontrer une femme très spéciale de Sheffield et de visiter des jardins incroyables avec une histoire fascinante.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Canaletto and the Art of Venice
programme.desc: Canaletto et l’art de Venise, un voyage en immersion dans la vie et l’art du célèbre peintre de Venise. Aucun artiste n’a su mieux capturer l’essence et le charme de cette ville que Giovanni Antonio Canal, plus connu sous le nom de Canaletto. La remarquable collection regroupe plus de 200 tableaux, dessins et eaux-fortes nous permet de partir à la découverte du talent artistique de Canaletto, de ses contemporains et de la ville qu’il a su reproduire avec génie. Le film ouvre également les portes de deux résidences royales officielles, Buckingham Palace et le château de Windsor, pour nous en apprendre plus sur l’artiste et sur Joseph Smith, l’homme qui a fait découvrir Canaletto à la Grande-Bretagne.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: This famous art gallery in Berlin holds one of the world’s leading collections of European works by Old Masters. Here you can find “The Fountain of Youth” by Cranach the Elder, or the earthy “Netherlandish Proverbs” illustrated by Bruegel. Allow yourself to be tempted by the sensuality of Correggio (“Leda and the Swan”) or of Titian (“Venus with Organist”), by the poetry of “The Glass of Wine”, a genre painting by Vermeer, or by the gracious “Iris or the Dance” by Watteau. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Art Quiz
programme.desc: Test and develop your artistic culture with Art Quiz, the game that will allow you to become unaware of art. Whether it's artists, works of art, artistic trends, the price of works... nothing will be a secret for you anymore. Now it's your turn to play!

programme.title: My little Museum
programme.desc: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: In 1871, a giant fire ravaged Chicago, providing a unique opportunity for a young generation of American architects to break away from the old continent and invent in Chicago the new forms of a specifically American architecture.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: L'École d'architecture de Porto, conçue par Álvaro Siza, reflète son approche minimaliste et respectueuse du contexte environnant. Inaugurée en 1993, l'école s'intègre harmonieusement dans le paysage, jouant sur des volumes simples et une lumière naturelle omniprésente. Siza a utilisé des matériaux modestes comme le béton blanc, conférant à l'ensemble une sobriété élégante. Les espaces sont conçus pour encourager l'interaction entre les étudiants et les enseignants, favorisant ainsi un environnement d'apprentissage ouvert et fluide. Ce bâtiment incarne parfaitement la philosophie architecturale de Siza, où fonction et poésie se rencontrent.

programme.title: Trésors Volés
programme.sub-title: Looting of the Gentili Di Giuseppe Collection
programme.desc: Federico Gentili di Giuseppe was a Jewish businessman of Italian origin with a passion for art. On his death in 1940, he bequeathed a collection of 150 paintings to his two children, Marcel and Adriana, who had become naturalised French citizens. In 1941, Maître Moulin auctioned off these paintings under questionable circumstances. This marked the beginning of a legal battle waged by the Gentili di Giuseppe heirs, which was to last nearly 50 years.

programme.title: Trésors Volés
programme.desc: Painted in 1911, Pablo Picasso’s "La Coiffeuse" is an iconic work of Cubism. The painting was last seen in 1998, following a loan for an exhibition in Munich. On its return to Paris, it was stored in the Centre Pompidou’s storerooms… until the day it was discovered to be missing, in 2001. Had it been stolen from the storerooms? Sixteen years after the theft, in 2014, a ship docked at the port of Newark, in New Jersey, USA. The artwork was on board….

programme.title: Trésors Volés
programme.sub-title: The 5 Masterpieces of the Museum of Modern Art – Paris
programme.desc: In 2010, five masterpieces by Picasso, Matisse, Braque, Modigliani and Léger went missing. A year into the investigation, the police arrested the burglar, Vrejan Tomic. A repeat offender, with 11 art thefts to his name, he usually works to order. In this case, the client was Jean-Michel Corvez. Wrapped in bin bags, these unsellable works were found at the home of a third man, Yonathan Birn. How? Why?

programme.title: Trésors Volés
programme.desc: Vandalised, stolen, cut into pieces, melted down and resold for a few thousand euros, even though they are worth millions: sculptures. On the night of 30–31 March 1999, whilst this park in the 6th arrondissement was closed to the public, individuals stole the sculpture of Picasso’s former muse and lover, Dora Maar: ‘Head of a Woman’, an 80-centimetre-tall bronze weighing 80 kilos. Two years later, in a town hall in the Paris suburbs, it stood proudly on the staircase: ‘Do you realise you’ve got a Picasso in your building?’ exclaimed an antique dealer who had come to visit the château. Indeed, the town hall had found a ‘large stone’ buried on a plot of land, had it cleaned, thought it was beautiful and displayed it in their château, unaware that it was a sculpture by Picasso….

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Le rockeur progressif Rick Wakeman et son grand ami Ian Lavender, célèbre pour son rôle de Pike dans Dad’s Army, s’offrent une joyeuse virée sur les routes secondaires du Norfolk. Accompagnés des experts Raj Bisram et David Harper, ces deux chasseurs d’antiquités sillonnent le comté à la recherche de trésors à vendre aux enchères à Nottingham.Rick découvre d’anciens graffitis médiévaux cachés dans la cathédrale de Norwich, tandis qu’Ian fait un détour vers le nord du Norfolk pour admirer la plus grande collection de soldats miniatures au monde.Mais un sage vieil homme japonais aidera-t-il Ian à triompher aux enchères ?

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Le paradoxe Nicolas Poussin ! Cet artiste incarne le peintre classique français par excellence alors qu’il passa la majeure partie de sa vie à Rome... C’est là qu’il construisit sa renommée, passant progressivement des commandes publiques aux commandes privées, pour ne plus se consacrer qu’à une clientèle d’amateurs d’art européens. Pour eux, il peignit des chefs d’œuvre que vous allez maintenant découvrir : Les bergers d’Arcadie, Le jugement de Salomon et les Quatre Saisons. Bonne visite ! 2013, France.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Pablo Picasso est l’un des plus grands artistes au monde, et jusqu’à sa mort en 1973, il était le plus prolifique. Comment tout a commencé ? Comment s’est construit Picasso ? Après avoir été trop longtemps ignorées, il est temps de se concentrer sur les jeunes années de l’artiste et son éducation qui lui ont permis d’accomplir l’extraordinaire. Trois villes ont joué un rôle-clé : Malaga, Barcelone et Paris. "Le jeune Picasso" les traverse et explore leur influence sur l’artiste, en analysant des œuvres spécifiques de ses débuts.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Cette exposition très attendue à la Royal Academy of Arts était la toute première rétrospective consacrée au portrait d'Édouard Manet. Couvrant l'ensemble de la carrière de cet artiste énigmatique et parfois controversé, l'exposition a rassemblé des œuvres provenant d'Europe, d'Asie et des États-Unis. Le portrait de Manet n'a jamais fait l'objet d'une exposition, bien qu'il représente environ la moitié de sa production artistique. Il a peint sa famille, ses amis et les personnalités littéraires, politiques et artistiques de l'époque, donnant vie non seulement à ses sujets mais aussi à la société parisienne.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Phil Grabsky, réalisateur récompensé à plusieurs reprises, pose un regard neuf sur celui qui est sans conteste l’artiste le plus aimé au monde en utilisant les mots du peintre lui-même. Moi, Claude Monet révèle de nouvelles facettes de l’homme qui a donné naissance au mouvement impressionniste grâce à un tableau et qui fut certainement l’un des peintres les plus influents et renommés du XIXe et du début du XXe siècle. Tourné à travers l’Europe, sur les lieux où il a peint, Moi, Claude Monet est une exploration filmique inédite et intime de certains des décors cultes les plus appréciés de l’art occidental.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: « J’envie les Japonais », écrivait Van Gogh à son frère, Théo. Grâce à l’exposition sur laquelle est basé ce film, « Van Gogh et le Japon », au musée Van Gogh d’Amsterdam, on comprend pourquoi. Bien que Vincent van Gogh n’ait jamais visité le Japon, il reste le pays qui a eu le plus d’influence sur lui et son œuvre. En se rendant dans les galeries d’art japonais à Paris et en créant sa propre image du Japon après des recherches approfondies, des collections d’estampes et de longues discussions avec d’autres artistes, la découverte des œuvres japonaises entraîna la carrière de Van Gogh dans une nouvelle direction très excitante.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Goya: Visions of Flesh and Blood
programme.desc: Francisco Goya, considéré comme le fondateur de l’art moderne, est l’artiste espagnol le plus acclamé. En plus d’observer avec talent la vie et le passé mouvementé de l’Espagne, c’est un portraitiste doué et un commentateur social par excellence. Avec Goya, l’art du portrait atteint de nouveaux sommets. Cette exposition majeure de la National Gallery de Londres remet son génie en lumière. À travers une formidable collection d’oeuvres uniques et de lettres de Goya, nous analysons l’homme lui-même et le monde qu’il peignait.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: David Hockney à la Royal Academy of Arts
programme.desc: David Hockney, généralement considéré comme l’un des artistes britanniques les plus populaires, connaît un succès mondial grâce à ses expositions à Londres, New York, Paris et ailleurs qui attirent des millions de spectateurs. Devenu récemment octogénaire, Hockney ne semble pas avoir l’intention de lever le pied ni de perdre son audace légendaire. Ce film révèle des interviews intimes et inédites et se concentre sur deux expositions à succès ayant eu lieu en 2012 et 2016 à la Royal Academy of Arts Londres. Le réalisateur Phil Grabsky a bénéficié d’un accès privilégié pour célébrer sur grand écran ce génie créatif du XXIe siècle.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les chefs télévisés Aldo Zilli et Ching He-Huang s’affrontent lors de ce Road Trip à travers le sud-est de l’Angleterre, accompagnés des experts Natasha Raskin et Paul Laidlaw.Aldo mise sur une bague en or malgré les conseils des experts, tandis que Ching espère que des antiquités d’origine orientale feront un beau score aux enchères dans le nord de Londres.En chemin, Aldo fait une halte pour rencontrer Jill, une doyenne de 200 ans qui fournissait autrefois la population en farine. De son côté, l’amoureuse des animaux Ching découvre l’histoire d’un homme qui, au XIXe siècle, a risqué le ridicule et la ruine pour protéger le bétail.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: It’s a journey into antiquity with glamorous historians Suzannah Lipscomb and Kate Williams. Paired with experts David Harper and Catherine Southon they Road Trip from Bletchley in Buckinghamshire to an auction in London. There’s also opportunity to hear how Mrs Beeton became the first ‘domestic Goddess’ and why Luton played a critical role in the fashion world when hats were de rigueur daily wear. David and Suzannah gamble on a giant ant while Catherine and Kate plump for a very large tea urn.

programme.sub-title: The 5 Masterpieces of the Museum of Modern Art – Paris

Wrapped in bin bags, these unsellable works were found at the home of a third man, Yonathan Birn. How? Why?

programme.title: Trésors Volés
programme.sub-title: Looting of the Gentili Di Giuseppe Collection
programme.desc: Federico Gentili di Giuseppe was a Jewish businessman of Italian origin with a passion for art. In 1941, Maître Moulin auctioned off these paintings under questionable circumstances. programme.title: Trésors Volés
programme.sub-title: Alley of Poplars by Sisley, Nice Museum of Fine Arts
programme.desc: Sisley was a British Impressionist painter, closely associated with Renoir and Monet. On 20 June 1978, at 8.30 pm, a truck was stolen. Inside were around ten masterpieces worth 1.5 billion francs. The transport company responsible for returning the works following a loan had made no security arrangements. On 21 September 1998, ‘The Avenue of Poplars’ was stolen once again. This time, it was the curator of the Musée des Beaux-Arts in Nice, Jean Fornéris, who staged his own abduction! Finally, on Sunday 5 August 2007, five masked and armed men held up staff at the Nice museum to steal four paintings, including the Sisley. It was not until 2008, with the help of the FBI – which was also searching for works stolen from the Boston Museum – that the thieves were arrested.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Paul Sérusier spent his entire summer of 1888 painting with Paul Gauguin in Pont-Aven, Brittany. This master of colour gave invaluable advice to the young Sérusier, who was part of the new generation of painters known as the Post-Impressionists. The Impressionists favoured the visual sensation of the motif, but they had not broken with the illusionist rendering of nature.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: In no way was Pierre Bonnard destined to be a painter. However, he became one of the pillars of the Nabi Movement. His work, more closely linked to emotions than to realism, is impossible to classify. It is punctuated with huge sunny landscapes, of both the Mediterranean and Normandy, with interior scenes, with nudes and self portraits. This exhibition offers you ten of the artist’s greatest paintings, such as his famous “Workshop with Mimosa” and his “Nude in Bathtub”. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Le Pavillon Allemand de l'exposition universelle de 1929 à Barcelone détient le rapport de la notoriété au m2 bâti. Un toit plat, 8 poteaux métalliques et une dizaine de parois. Comment et pourquoi cette structure minimale en est-elle venue à incarner la modernité du XXème siècle ? En dehors de sa dimension iconique, le Pavillon n'a pas d'autre fonction que d'abriter pour moins d'une heure une unique réception du roi et de la reine d'Espagne, le jour de l'inauguration de l'exposition. Mies van der Rohe donne ici sa propre vision de la nouvelle architecture.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Gutenberg est considéré comme le père de l’imprimerie moderne. La petite histoire raconte qu’il se serait inspiré du pressoir à raisin utilisé par les vignerons pour inventer sa machine. De cette anecdote historique, deux artistes ont entrepris d’éditer un livre qui étanchera la soif de n’importe quel lecteur gourmand. Dans cet épisode, nous rencontrerons Luz et Anaïs, deux artistes opposées et absolument complémentaires.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Strictly Come Dancing’s Zoe Ball and Ian Waite are quickstepping their way across the south West of England in a bid to turn a profit at auction in Hampshire. Experts Margie Cooper and Paul Laidlaw are on hand to guide. Paul shares a secret with Zoe about buying antique hair brushes. Ian, though, offers dancing lessons to dealers to secure a discount. Lordy! Zoe also hears how one village became world famous for lace production while Ian ends up meeting a giant horse with its own boat.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Jean-Honoré Fragonard.You will discover his labour with Psyche showing her sisters her gifts from cupid, The storm, Night scene or the Beggar’s dream.

programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Edouard Manet.You will discover his labour with Lola de valence, Olympia, Eel and red mullet.

programme.desc: Massage studio will show you the best massage techniques in places which will make you dream. Let us take care of you! Lay down, relax and forget all your problems.

programme.title: Namaste Yoga
programme.sub-title: Open and Ground: Stretch Your Shoulders and Strengthen Your Upper Back
programme.desc: A dynamic sequence for your upper body, Open and Ground will work your torso with a series of restorative and heart opening poses. By keeping a steady connection to the earth and lifting and opening the chest, the experience of opposing forces can be fully explored.

programme.title: Home training
programme.desc: This episode of "Home Training" offers an intense cardio-training session. Guillaume and Sabrina invite participants to push themselves with dynamic and rhythmic exercises. The goal is to raise the heart rate to improve endurance and burn calories. This session is ideal for those who want to work out while having fun. Get ready to move and sweat in an energetic and motivating atmosphere.

programme.title: Pilates
programme.desc: Stay in shape with our pilates courses!

programme.title: Namaste Yoga
programme.sub-title: Recharge and Revitalize: Hip and Shoulder Opening
programme.desc: Allow your breath to be bigger than the movements of your body in this invigorating sequence. All other instructions are secondary, as this sequence calls on you to use your breath as the only mediator between mind and body. Use this steady rhythm to inform your every moment of your life and practice.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: What will they think of their new interior? How many points will they award? Their score could change everything and completely overturn the current rankings. The final hope for our decorators is to be Valérie Damidot's favourite and win a bonus point. So who will win the competition? Who will walk away with €2,000 and the title of decorating ace? Today is the day of the grand final, before we see the reaction of the owners and find out their scores. Each contestant will find out what the other contestants thought of their decorating choices.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie is offering you a trip to the south of France. Between the Rhone Valley and the Mediterranean, let's discover a fruit that is harvested in November: the olive.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Nous entamerons ce périple près de la Rochelle pour en apprendre un peu plus sur l’élevage des fameuses moules de bouchot mais aussi une technique bien particulière pour les cuisiner. Nous partirons ensuite pour un tour de France des meilleures huîtres : direction Cancale, Arcachon, Montpellier et enfin Oléron pour connaître les différentes méthodes d’élevage et s’y retrouver un peu plus parmi toutes les espèces de l’hexagone. Julie cuisinera une fricassée de berniques, les petits chapeaux chinois qui recouvrent les rochers du littoral mais aussi des palourdes roses méconnues du grand public. Nous poursuivrons notre route dans le Finistère pour rencontrer Sylvain, le seul éleveur d’ormeau du pays puis à Méru où se trouve encore des ateliers magnifiant ce sublime matériau. Le Chef Jean-Marie Baudic nous cuisine les coquilles Saint-Jacques comme personne.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Cap au Nord pour découvrir une ville française absolument incontournable : Lille. Cette ville possède un patrimoine architectural exceptionnel, marchande dès le Moyen Age, citadelle sous Louis XIV, industrielle au XIXe...elle s'agrandit au cours des siècles. Julie ira à la rencontre de ceux qui participent à la renommée de la ville et de la région, et à travers son patrimoine culinaire avec au menu de ce voyage : la recette du coq à la bière, celle du hochepot, et sur une note sucrée, une crème brûlée à la chicorée. .

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo cooks chickpeas. As they originate from the Middle East, she decides to prepare Lebanese recipes. On the menu: fallafel with chickpeas, kumquat, spices and cinnamon, and chard with chickpeas, parsley, mint and bulgur.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo puts Normandy in the spotlight! With the region's president, Hervé Morin, she prepares apples poached in cinnamon syrup, as well as mussels... in her own way.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: How can we reconcile the development needed to sustain the lives of nearly seven billion people with the protection of the Earth's natural resources? Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team have chosen Gabon to continue their survey of the planet. We'll be discovering the Kongou Falls, the Langoué clearing with their elephant in Gabon. Then in Colombia, we will go on the island of Malpelo with their shark. Back to Gabon we will discover the Minkébé National Park and the bats in Franceville. We will also go to India in Hyderabad, which has convinced farmers to use no pesticides and no GMOs in their cultivation.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Les Héros de la Nature : Sénégal - Partie 2
programme.desc: For this new episode, Yann Arthus-Bertrand travels through Senegal to encounter men and women who dedicate their lives to preserving the environment. One of the major ecological stakes of the country is fishing and the mangrove ecosystem which, like in some many other parts of the world, faces major threats. Yann Arthus-Bertrand presents the struggle of Haidar El Ali, chosen among one of the world’s most active ecologists. He creates protected marine areas and reforests the disappeared mangrove of his country. He’s managed to convince thousands of Senegalese to plant with him ten million mangrove trees.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Les Héros de la Nature : Sénégal - Partie 1
programme.desc: For this new episode, Yann Arthus-Bertrand travels through Senegal to encounter men and women who dedicate their lives to preserving the environment. One of the major ecological stakes of the country is fishing and the mangrove ecosystem which, like in some many other parts of the world, faces major threats. Yann Arthus-Bertrand presents the struggle of Haidar El Ali, chosen among one of the world’s most active ecologists. He creates protected marine areas and reforests the disappeared mangrove of his country. He’s managed to convince thousands of Senegalese to plant with him ten million mangrove trees.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Défendre l’eau c’est défendre la vie - Partie 2
programme.desc: On se retrouve en Israël dans le désert du Neguev, Elaine cherche des solutions pour lutter contre la désertification. L’objet de ses recherches : les arbres, peu consommateurs d’eau. Au Mali, on retrouve les Dogons : les cultivateurs du désert. Il nous fait découvrir les recettes de son peuple pour gérer l’eau. Dans cette partie du Mali où il ne pleut quasiment jamais. En Palestine, le village de Wadi Fukeen. Un village où les agriculteurs utilisent un système d’irrigation et de partage de l’eau vieux de plus de 300 ans et basé sur le respect et la confiance. Et en Palestine à Gaza où les spécialistes se battent pour sauver des enfants palestiniens rendus malades par de l’eau impropre à la consommation. Dans la Vallée du Jourdain où trois pays en conflit affrontent les mêmes problèmes : le manque d’eau. Au Brésil, dans le château d’eau du Brésil où l’eau, d’une pureté exceptionnelle est menacée par l’exploitation du minerai de fer qui pollue la nappe phréatique. Et à.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Defending water is defending life - Part 2
programme.desc: Les océans recouvrent plus de 70 % de la surface de la Terre. La mer est le plus vaste environnement naturel de notre planète et demeure quasiment inexploitée. En Corse, depuis une tour du Capo Rosso ainsi que dans les Calanques de Piana. Aux Galapagos, nous avons réalisé le portrait de Paul Watson, écologiste et co-fondateur de Greenpeace. Ce Canadien au physique de baroudeur a pris la défense des animaux marins. En Corse, dans les Bouches de Bonifacio, le bassin méditerranéen est l'un des plus riches en biodiversité de la planète avec comme objectif de préserver les côtes de l’urbanisation et protéger la vie marine. En Corse, avec la surpêche. Dans le monde, 75% des stocks de poissons sont menacés par la surexploitation. La cause ? La pêche à grande échelle, gaspilleuse et pas assez régulée. En Guinée-Bissau, les Bijagos, c’est un chapelet d’une centaine d’îles, dans ces eaux, le poisson abonde mais pour combien de temps encore ? En Corse, sur les Iles Sanguinaires, près de 50% des.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, we're off to discover summer fruits, which are harvested from June to August: peaches, melons, strawberries, raspberries... We'll then head to the cherry capital, Céret, and cook blueberries, strawberries and an apricot charlotte.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: How can we reconcile the development needed to sustain the lives of nearly seven billion people with the protection of the Earth's natural resources? Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team have chosen Gabon to continue their survey of the planet. We'll be discovering the Kongou Falls, the Langoué clearing with their elephant in Gabon. Then in Colombia, we will go on the island of Malpelo with their shark. Back to Gabon we will discover the Minkébé National Park and the bats in Franceville. We will also go to India in Hyderabad, which has convinced farmers to use no pesticides and no GMOs in their cultivation.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: The incredible diversity of flora and fauna, the fight against climate change, the balance between growth and sustainable development: these are all battles being fought on five continents. Yann Arthus-Bertrand takes us on this expedition. We're off to Gabon to discover the Ivindo National Park and Port-Gentil, then on to Sri Lanka in Kandi. Back to Gabon we go to Libreville, then Lambaréné to talk about turtles and the health of the local people. Finally, off to Dhaka-Bangladesh.

programme.desc: If the Atlantis Bahamas isn’t on your family's bucket list - it should be! We’ll show you why as each family member ticks off their dream adventure that also gives back. Proving this big resort has an even bigger heart.

programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints
programme.desc: Sometimes exploring the road less traveled gives you the biggest adventure. In this episode, we escape the city buzz and opt for a quieter life on a Texas dude ranch. Taking time to appreciate the beauty in history, animals and quality time as a family.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

We'll visit Brittany, then the Normandy coast where fishing is the regional sport, and Corsica, where the far northeast of the island lives to the rhythm of lobster. Julie takes us to cook lobster, crab with a very special recipe, and langoustines.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie nous donne rendez-vous à Bordeaux après avoir arpenté le pays de Blaye, visité deux fois le bassin et parcouru les terres du Libournais à deux reprises, il fallait bien s’arrêter un jour dans la capitale du Bordelais ! N’y-a-t-il pas meilleure saison que le mois de septembre pour découvrir la perle d’Aquitaine, plus souvent appelée « Cité du vin » ? Julie donne rendez-vous à ces habitants pour découvrir les traditions mais aussi les projets plus récents de cette ville chargée d’Histoire et de gastronomie.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: We are in the middle of the harvest season, a perfect opportunity to discover the most beautiful French vineyards.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie prend la direction de la Bourgogne pour découvrir des races anciennes de volaille réintroduites en France grâce au travail de l’éleveur Fred Ménager. Nous nous rapprocherons ensuite de l’Auvergne pour découvrir comment est attribué le fameux Label Rouge et le rôle des organismes certificateurs … car il est important de savoir ce qui atterri dans nos assiettes. Julie se rendra aussi dans la Drôme pour cuisiner de la pintade avant de se diriger vers le Périgord pour préparer un civet de dindon. Installée dans sa petite Micheline, Julie remontera ensuite vers le centre pour découvrir un étonnant fabricant de mouche qui utilise des plumes de coqs !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Si l’été est la saison où les légumes abondent au potager, il serait dommage de ne pas savourer ceux que les saisons plus fraîches nous offrent : potages, tourtes, potées ou gratins mettent à l’honneur des légumes de saisons, idéals pour se réchauffer. Pour débuter ce nouveau voyage, un légume qui trônait déjà sur les tables de la Grèce Antique : le salsifis que Julie cuisinera avec une drôle de tourtière…L’hiver c’est aussi la saison du chou alors direction la Champagne pour y apprendre la recette de la potée locale qui devrait remplir le ventre d’un grand nombre de convives.Ce petit tour de France nous emmènera aussi à la découverte d’orfèvres du maraîchage qui sculptent légumes et fruits d’hiver, et vous présentera différentes techniques et méthodes pour sublimer vos potagers.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Les Héros de la Nature : Sénégal - Partie 2
programme.desc: For this new episode, Yann Arthus-Bertrand travels through Senegal to encounter men and women who dedicate their lives to preserving the environment. One of the major ecological stakes of the country is fishing and the mangrove ecosystem which, like in some many other parts of the world, faces major threats. Yann Arthus-Bertrand presents the struggle of Haidar El Ali, chosen among one of the world’s most active ecologists. He creates protected marine areas and reforests the disappeared mangrove of his country. He’s managed to convince thousands of Senegalese to plant with him ten million mangrove trees.

programme.desc: On se retrouve en Israël dans le désert du Neguev, Elaine cherche des solutions pour lutter contre la désertification. L’objet de ses recherches : les arbres, peu consommateurs d’eau. Au Mali, on retrouve les Dogons : les cultivateurs du désert. Il nous fait découvrir les recettes de son peuple pour gérer l’eau. Dans cette partie du Mali où il ne pleut quasiment jamais. En Palestine, le village de Wadi Fukeen. Un village où les agriculteurs utilisent un système d’irrigation et de partage de l’eau vieux de plus de 300 ans et basé sur le respect et la confiance. Et en Palestine à Gaza où les spécialistes se battent pour sauver des enfants palestiniens rendus malades par de l’eau impropre à la consommation. Dans la Vallée du Jourdain où trois pays en conflit affrontent les mêmes problèmes : le manque d’eau. Au Brésil, dans le château d’eau du Brésil où l’eau, d’une pureté exceptionnelle est menacée par l’exploitation du minerai de fer qui pollue la nappe phréatique. Et à.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there. But Fontainebleau has many other treasures in its bag, and gastronomy is part of its heritage. This is what Julie will discover through three recipes: Quail with grapes, raspberry and poppy pie and crayfish grave.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C'est à Giverny que démarre le voyage de Julie, celui dont le nom résonne immédiatement comme le berceau de l’Impressionnisme a gardé une authenticité émouvante, Giverny impose son style, murmure son histoire. Sa notoriété est fortement liée à la présence historique de Claude Monet et à tous les fabuleux témoins laissés par ce dernier. Claude Monet a aussi laissé son empreinte dans la cuisine à Giverny. Ses carnets de recettes sont là pour en témoigner. C’est dans ces carnets que Julie va s’inspirer pour remplir le sien, au menu : Lapin en compote, feuilleté d’andouilles au camembert, et charlottes aux abricots.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Health Investigation
programme.desc: With 8 million dogs and 14 million cats, the French hold the world record for pet ownership. Whilst these four-legged companions soothe and stimulate us, they actually do much more than that: they heal us! And this has been scientifically proven. Having a pet at home has numerous benefits for our physical and mental well-being.Better cardiovascular health, a stronger immune system and gut microbiota, and the release of oxytocin – the ‘happiness hormone’… There are countless studies demonstrating the physical, psychological and emotional benefits of this bond between humans and animals.For the past forty years or so, animal-assisted therapy has been growing in popularity in France. Dogs, cats, horses and certain farm animals now work alongside therapists to offer a new approach to care. In care homes, dogs help to rekindle the desire to communicate in elderly people suffering from Alzheimer’s disease. For children with psychomotor disabilities, horses facilitate functional rehabilitat.

programme.title: Health Investigation
programme.desc: Depression is an illness that will affect more than one in five people during their lifetime. To overcome it, more than 4 million French people take antidepressants, which are essential in certain cases.For many doctors, treating depression solely with medication has become routine, whether the depression is severe, moderate or mild. This practice is increasingly contested, as antidepressants and anti-anxiety drugs cause numerous side effects and, in some cases, can lead to dependence. They are now viewed with suspicion and mistrust by many patients who are seeking alternative treatments.Over the past few years, alternative, non-pharmacological methods have emerged to treat depression. Some therapies have even found their way into hospitals.Studies have, for example, shown that therapies based on mindfulness meditation are just as effective as standard treatments with antidepressants in preventing relapses of depression. Another technique that is rapidly gaining ground is transcrani.

programme.title: Health Investigation
programme.desc: Paracetamol, ibuprofen or aspirin… Painkillers are everywhere in our medicine cabinets. These treatments are so commonplace that we all too often forget the dangers they pose. First and foremost is paracetamol. Fourteen packets are sold every second in France. Often perceived as harmless, paracetamol is extremely toxic in the event of an overdose. For the 10 million French people who suffer from chronic pain, conventional painkillers are no longer sufficient, and it is often necessary to resort to painkillers derived from morphine and opium. The problem is that these medicines, such as Tramadol, can lead to serious addiction. Over the past ten years, the use of these medicines has risen sharply in France, causing concern amongst health authorities as these painkillers are wreaking havoc in the United States. Every day, 130 Americans die from an opioid-related overdose, which has become the leading cause of preventable death among people under the age of 50, far ahead of road traffic ac.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Det blir en travel uke med falske alarmer, nødssituasjoner til alle døgnets tider og detektivarbeid ved Pols veterinærklinikk. Selv ikke et hestespark i hodet stanser dr. Pol i å rykke ut for å hjelpe dyrene.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Høsten forvandler Karpatenes fjellsider til et bølgende teppe av bronse, ravgult og gull. Skogene fylles av kronhjortenes mektige brøl, som varsler kampen om retten til å samle en flokk med hinder. Oppgjørene er brutale, og de svekkede taperne blir et lett bytte for ulveflokker på jakt etter et enkelt måltid. For bjørnene gjelder det å fråtse i bær og nøtter for å legge på seg før vinterdvalen. Til tross for sin enorme størrelse klatrer de opp bøke- og furustammer for å nå de saftigste nøttene i trekronene. De går også inn på menneskenes åkere for å forsyne seg av mais. De gjør nesten hva som helst for å stille sulten. Alle disse storslåtte dyrenes overlevelse avhenger av de gamle skogene. De gamle trærne binder skadelig karbon fra atmosfæren og bidrar til å regulere jordas klima, en livsviktig funksjon for alt liv.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Alpebukker springer ned fra de bratte klippene, himmelen fylles av millioner av fugler under det imponerende trekket, og midt på vinteren leter den sjeldne gaupa etter en make.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: Sør-Amerika er et kontinent med ekstreme variasjoner, der man finner flere hundre tusen kvadratkilometer med skog, sletter og fjell. Det er tøft å overleve her. Noen dyr har utviklet seg til å bli veldig store eller svært små, og begge strategiene skal øke sjansen for å overleve.

programme.title: Ville Argentina
programme.desc: Hvaler, pingviner og sjøløver, som føder unger her, er blant sjødyrene som tiltrekkes av Argentinas 5000 km lange kyststripe. Fra første åndedrag er det én ting som gjelder for ungene: å overleve. Spekkhuggere jakter på unge sjøløver med en spesiell teknikk, mens måker angriper hvalungene. Vi får se dyrenes utrolige adferd gjennom noen fantastiske opptak under vann, noe som gjør Christian Baumasters film til en stor visuell opplevelse.

programme.title: Ville Argentina
programme.desc: I Argentinas fantastiske, men tøffe villmark må dyrene kjempe for å overleve hver eneste dag. Terrenget er karrig og ulendt, lufta er tynn og været kan endre seg på et blunk. En puma sniker seg gjennom dalføret på jakt etter en guanako, mens en tarantell forsvarer seg mot et sultent beltedyr. Revene spiser av byttene de finner inntil en stor rovfugl dukker opp. Samtidig holder isbreene på ferskvannet som dyrene så sårt trenger.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Denne familiegården trenger en låve! Pol-familien er klare til å ta fatt på sitt neste store prosjekt: Å bevare og forsiktig demontere en 100 år gammel låve. For hver del de plukker ned, desto mer skjør blir låven. Det er ikke rom for feil hvis de skal frakte disse uerstattelige bjelkene tilbake til gården og gjenopprette den til dens tidligere prakt.

programme.title: Gigantiske haier
programme.desc: Norfolkøyene er hjemsted for de største tigerhaiene på jorden, men hvorfor er de så store? Forskerne mistenker en uvanlig diett av kassert storfekjøtt.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Pol-familien har nådd det farligste stadiet med å demontere den 100 år gamle låven: Å ta ned bjelkene. Så, hvis alt går bra, vil de frakte bjelkene tilbake til gården. Hver del av denne prosessen må orkestreres nøye for å beskytte disse uerstattelige bjelkene. I mellomtiden prøver Beth å trene Clovis etter at han rømmer fra gården.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: Vest i Middelhavet ligger Portugal, med et mangfold av økosystemer som huser et imponerende rikt dyreliv. Mange av artene finnes bare i denne delen av verden og er tett knyttet sammen i et økosystem som gir dyrene grunnlag for å overleve i et til tider krevende landskap. En ildsalamander, som kan bli opptil 50 år gammel, nyter sitt første måltid etter å ha tilbrakt den tørre sommeren i dvale under jorden. Iberiagaupa, en av verdens sjeldneste villkatter, jakter på favorittbyttet sitt, kanin. Kongeørn og rev, som vanligvis er rivaler, tolererer hverandre lenge nok til å dele et bytte. Samtidig forbereder unge pyreneersteinbukker seg på voksenlivet ved å bryne hornene mot hverandre i en imponerende styrkeprøve.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Sommeren byr på overflod, men i kappløpet om å utnytte den korte varme årstiden følger også konkurranse, aggresjon og fare. Høyt oppe på fjellengene kjemper alpemurmeldyrene om de beste hiene der de kan oppfostre ungene sine. Men klarer de å unnslippe sultne bjørner? Bjørnungene i Karpatene vokser raskt, men trues av voksne hannbjørner som vil kvitte seg med rivalenes avkom. Klarer binnene å beskytte dem med sine smarte strategier? Flokker av europeisk bison dundrer gjennom de gamle skogene på jakt etter mat og vann. De er et av de fremste eksemplene på vellykket reintroduksjon, fordi tråkkene deres skaper liv i hele skogen og gir gode vilkår for milliarder av insekter. Insektene søker videre til kronhjortflokkene etter næring. Plaget av stikkende insekter trekker hjortene opp i fjellene for å slippe dem, men der risikerer de i stedet å bli bytte for sjeldne villkatter.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Bli med inn i den australske villmarken og oppdag en fascinerende verden av dyreunger som vokser opp langt fra byene og kysten. Møt unge wombater som utforsker livet under bakken, og små maurpiggsvinunger som utvikler de beskyttende piggene de trenger for å overleve. Se ville brumbyføll finne fotfestet i det ulendte landskapet, mens peeweeunger, australtrielens unger og monarksommerfuglens larver møter sine egne utfordringer på veien mot voksenlivet. Alle dyreungene må lære hva de kan spise, hvordan de unngår farer og hvilke ferdigheter de trenger for å klare seg på egen hånd. Gjennom lek, utforsking og foreldrenes veiledning forbereder de seg på et liv på egne ben. Underveis er vi vitne til utrolige forvandlinger, fascinerende foreldrestrategier og helt særegne tilpasninger som gjør det mulig for dyrene å overleve i den australske naturen.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Dr. Michele følger med staben for et intensivkurs i gårdstilfeller – i dr. Pol-stil! Dr. Michele valgte en god uke som sparkes i gang med aggressive okser, en motvillig hest som trenger tannpleie og en rekke drektighetskontroller. Det dukker også opp et nødstilfelle med et geitekje, og vi møter en liten katt med et lamt bein.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: I ukas "Den fantastiske dr. Pol" må veterinærene hjelpe to mødre som strever med fødselen, og de behandler flere eldre hunder. I tillegg rykker de ut til alpakkaer, besøkskaninen Luna og den søte geitekillingen Twinkie.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Store okser, løpske kalver og hylende griser gjør det til en travel uke i "Den fantastiske dr. Pol". Veterinærene har fullt opp med å hjelpe dyrene som kommer inn, og det er ikke alltid så lett.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: Alpene er i endring, ikke gjennom dramatiske omveltninger, men sakte og gradvis. Stigende temperaturer og flere tiår med menneskelig påvirkning forandrer fjellområdet, som lenge har vært preget av stabile forhold. Steinbukker, murmeldyr og fjellryper møter ulike utfordringer i høyfjellet, men endringene åpner også for nye muligheter. Hvordan vil de ulike artene tilpasse seg? Nede i dalene truer endrede elveløp fuglearter som hekker på åpne grusbanker. Opplev en sårbar verden i stadig forandring.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: Tysklands Mittelgebirge fascinerer med eldgamle skoger og urørt natur. Gjennom høstskogen runger kronhjortens kraftige brøl i tåken. Brunsten er i gang. I Sächsische Schweiz holder vandrefalker og svartstork til blant dramatiske klippeformasjoner. Den sky gaupa streifer gjennom skogene, mens et nytt og villere skoglandskap vokser fram i Harz i takt med et klima i endring.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: Vest i Middelhavet ligger Portugal, med et mangfold av økosystemer som huser et imponerende rikt dyreliv. Samtidig forbereder unge pyreneersteinbukker seg på voksenlivet ved å bryne hornene mot hverandre i en imponerende styrkeprøve.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: Langs Portugals kyst er livet både vakkert og brutalt for de unike artene som lever der, fra mikroskopisk planteplankton til enorme spermhvaler. Vinkekrabbene kjemper om retten til å pare seg i kystlagunene. Sepiablekksprutenen, en mester i kamuflasje, sniker seg inn på intetanende byttedyr. Storker bygger reir på de bratte klippene langs Atlanterhavskysten og vokter ungene sine mot rovdyr.

programme.title: Gredos - King of the Mountains
programme.desc: Gjennom årstidens skiftende sykluser åpenbarer Spanias nasjonalpark Sierra de Gredos seg som et av Europas mest bemerkelsesverdige naturlandskap. Fra eldgamle isbreer og dype fjellkløfter til toppen av Pico Almanzor, det høyeste fjellet i sentrale Spania, kan du bli kjent med et unikt og sårbart økosystem. Her hersker den iberiske steinbukken, en ikonisk art som er innbegrepet av disse fjellene. Ved siden av den lever kongeørner, fjellfugler og otere i et område preget av isolasjon og motstandskraft. Dette er et portrett av villmark og balanse, et vindu inn i et av Europas siste store villmarksområder.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Australias elver, våtmarker, innsjøer og elvesletter gir perfekte oppvekstvilkår for et enestående mangfold av unge dyr. Vi møter en broket samling dyreunger som tar sine første skritt, svømmetak og dykk ut i verden. Nyklekte saltvannskrokodiller kommer fram under moras årvåkne blikk, griseneseskilpadder skynder seg mot vannet etter regntiden, og rumpetroll gjennomgår en av naturens mest fascinerende forvandlinger på veien mot livet som frosk.Samtidig lærer ungene til svartsvaner, australsivkyllinger og blåsultankyllinger, sammen med unge vannagamer og sultne hegreunger, å finne mat, unngå farer og tilegne seg ferdighetene de trenger som voksne. Familiebånd, samarbeid, instinkt og tilpasningsevne hjelper dem med å takle utfordringene som venter i Australias våtmarker og vassdrag.
